title: URL shortener service v1
summary: A stateless HTTP API backed by a persistent store that creates short links, redirects visitors to the original URL, exposes link metadata and click analytics, and is operable in production (probes, structured errors, durable data).

functional.statement: A client can create a short link for an http(s) URL.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/links with a valid URL returns 201 with code, short_url, long_url and created_at
The code is 7 base62 characters and unique
A missing, malformed, non-http(s) or over-long URL returns 422 with a problem document

functional.statement: Opening a short link redirects to the original URL.
acceptance_criteria: GET /{code} returns 307 with the long URL in Location
An unknown code returns 404

functional.statement: A client can look up a link's metadata.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/links/{code} returns the stored link
An unknown code returns 404

functional.statement: A client can remove a link.
acceptance_criteria: DELETE /api/v1/links/{code} returns 204 and is idempotent
A removed link answers 410 on redirect and keeps its metadata and analytics

functional.statement: The service reports how often each link is used.
acceptance_criteria: Every successful redirect is recorded with its time and referrer
GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats returns total clicks, the last click time and a per-day breakdown

non_functional.statement: Reliability: the service is operable in production.
acceptance_criteria: Liveness and readiness probes exist; readiness fails when the database is unreachable
Data survives a process restart
No request path returns an unhandled 500 for bad input; code collisions are retried a bounded number of times

non_functional.statement: Security: untrusted input cannot alter queries, logs or stored data shape.
acceptance_criteria: All SQL uses bound parameters
URLs, codes and headers are validated or bounded before use
No secrets in the codebase

non_functional.statement: Observability: requests can be correlated across logs.
acceptance_criteria: Every response carries an X-Request-ID; a safe caller-supplied id is propagated
Each request is logged with method, path, status and duration

non_functional.statement: Maintainability: the code is layered, configurable and tested.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP, business rules and persistence are separate modules
Configuration comes from environment variables with working defaults
Line coverage is at least 85 percent and the OpenAPI schema is published

assumptions.statement: The API is unauthenticated in v1; it is deployed behind a trusted gateway.
A single instance with an embedded database is sufficient for the prototype's load.
Shortening the same URL twice yields two independent links.
'Basic analytics' means click counts over time, not visitor identity.
